## Orientation

Territory: ~/adaptive-artifacts (src/, pyproject.toml, bin/, tools/ shims, sync-plugin). Not affidavit worktree.

Concurrency: alone in wave 2.

Operational: AA extension approved. Commit in AA repo. Affidavit store writes stay on primary affidavit checkout.

### Requirements
R1: pyproject.toml + adaptive-artifacts entry point
R4: plugin bin/adaptive-artifacts still works
R5: tools/artifacts.py shim still works

### Decisions
- packaging-scope-aa-first → aa-first-git-tool-install
- aa-checkout-shims → keep-bin-and-tools-shims
